source.quote: applies exact parent hints as a score floor

obligations.statement: A parent named in parentActionHints ('music' for MUSIC) gets the exact-hint score floor in retrieveActions' results even when the message text ('do the thing') does not match it.

source.quote: matches candidate action namespaces and child names with regex scoring

obligations.statement: retrieveActions matches a candidate action given as a namespace pattern ('calendar_*') or as a child action name ('PLAY_TRACK') to its parent action through regex scoring.

source.quote: uses BM25 over message text plus candidate action terms

obligations.statement: retrieveActions scores parents with BM25 over the message text together with the terms of the candidate actions (such as 'create event').

source.quote: does not emit measurement output when measurementMode is off (default)

obligations.statement: When measurementMode is not set, retrieveActions returns a response with no measurement output.

source.quote: produces identical results when measurementMode is off vs on

obligations.statement: For the same input, retrieveActions returns identical results whether measurementMode is off or on.

source.quote: captures per-stage scores under measurement mode

obligations.statement: With measurementMode on, retrieveActions records the score each stage gave in its measurement output, including for parent hints and candidate actions.

source.quote: emits a fused topK list sorted by RRF score descending

obligations.statement: With measurementMode on, retrieveActions emits a fused top-K list ordered by RRF score from highest to lowest.

source.quote: captures contextMatch stage entries when selectedContexts intersect

obligations.statement: With measurementMode on, when selectedContexts intersect an action's contexts, retrieveActions records contextMatch stage entries for that action.
retrieveActions returns no more results than tierOverrides.topK allows (topK 2 gives at most 2 results).
retrieveActions applies tierOverrides.stageWeights when it fuses the stage rankings with RRF, so a changed stage weight changes the fused scores.
